basic_info.description: Welcome to this charming single-family home in the vibrant Sunset neighborhood! Ideally located with easy access to transportation, local restaurants, coffee shops, and Golden Gate Park, this residence offers the perfect blend of convenience and lifestyle. The main level boasts a spacious open floor plan where the living, dining, and recently remodeled kitchen flow seamlessly together, creating a bright and inviting space filled with natural light. Two comfortable bedrooms and a full bath complete this level, highlighted by new Marvin windows on the front facade that enhance both curb appeal and interior comfort.    Downstairs, discover a versatile layout with an additional bedroom and full bath, plus ample storage, a dedicated laundry and office area, and direct access to the back deck. Step outside to enjoy the expansive flat yard, perfect for entertaining, gardening, or simply relaxing.    With its thoughtful updates, stylish design, and flexible floor plan, this home beautifully balances comfort and practicality, capturing the quintessential San Francisco lifestyle.
